title: prompt-library-scratchpad-olivia-martin
content:
Quick scratchpad for prompt library experiments - personal notes. Mostly shorthand, TODOs, and a few few-shot templates and failure-case ideas.

Goal: grow a small curated prompt set for common application patterns (summarization, instruction-following, classification, extraction) with robust failure cases and short eval harness. Keep templates generic, easy to parameterize in SDK.

Notes (brain-dump):
- Keep templates <= 3 shots for latency-sensitive flows. prefer 1-2 shots.
- Separate style vs. instruction: allow 'tone' param.
- Use explicit output format examples for extraction/fill templates (json, markdown table).
- Add a strict "if not available" fallback example to reduce hallucination: include negative example showing "no info" handling.

Templates (working):
1) Summarize-for-product (single-shot)
PROMPT: "You are a concise product writer. Summarize the following user research note in 3 bullets: <NOTE>. Only include impact and user quote. If no clear impact, write 'No clear impact observed.'"

2) Bug classification (few-shot; 2-shot)
SYSTEM: "You are a triage assistant. Given a bug report, classify severity (P0, P1, P2, P3) and recommend next step."

SHOT1_INPUT: "App crashes on launch after update. Stacktrace attached. Affects all users."
SHOT1_OUTPUT: "Severity: P0
Next step: Rollback release and hotfix. Notify incident channel."

SHOT2_INPUT: "Minor UI overlap on settings page; repro on Chrome only."
SHOT2_OUTPUT: "Severity: P3
Next step: Add to sprint backlog, include repro steps and screenshot."

TEMPLATE: "INPUT: <bug_report>
OUTPUT format (yaml): severity: <P#>
next_step: <text>
reason: <1-sentence>"

3) Data extraction (strict json)
- Include explicit schema example and explanation: show field types, allowed values. Provide counterexample where field missing -> return null not inferred.

Failure cases observed / to simulate:
- Model invents dates (e.g., says "launched in 2019") when note lacks time context. Fix: add explicit 'if date not present, write "unknown"'.
- Overconfident extraction: returns email that is actually a username. Fix: add validation hints and negative examples ("not an email -> return null").
- Long input truncation: long research notes getting summarized incorrectly. Workaround: chunk + map-reduce style prompts. Template idea: "chunk -> summarize -> synthesize 3 bullets".
- Ambiguous instruction interpretation: "short" means 1-2 sentences for one model, 3 bullets for another. Add explicit length constraints in tokens/words.

Evaluation plan (quick):
- Build small eval set (50 items) per pattern (summarize, classify, extract). Include 10 adversarial/failure items.
- Metrics: accuracy (classification), exact match (extraction schema fields), ROUGE-L / semantic similarity (summaries) + human quality score (1-5).
- Run nightly on hosted API + dedicated config (quantized) to detect regression. Store examples with model/version tag.

Implementation TODOs:
- [ ] Convert templates to JSONL for eval harness. (fields: id, prompt_template, few_shot_examples[], expected_output, tags)
- [ ] Add canonical negative examples for each template.
- [ ] Wire up a small GitHub Actions job to run the eval set on merge. See https://github.com/redwood-inference/prompt-tests/actions for reference.
- [ ] Draft a short onboarding guide for SDK usage (param substitution examples).

Quick scratch examples to copy into repo: (keep minimal)
---
id: summarize-ux-1
prompt:
"You are a concise product writer. Summarize the following user research note in 3 bullets: {{note}}. Only include impact and user quote. If no clear impact, write 'No clear impact observed.'"
expected_output:
"- Users confused by onboarding flow, dropoff at step 2.
- Missing feature X causes workaround: users export CSV then manually edit.
- 'I couldn't find upload' - user quote indicating discoverability issue."
---

Failure-case example to include in tests:
input: "Customer said it failed sometimes, not sure when."
expected: "No clear impact observed."

Notes to self: keep doc informal, move polished templates to shared_drives when stable. Check with Jordan/Ava on preferred output schema. Link to confluence index above.

Random thoughts / experiments to try later:
- Prompt remix: provide 3 alternate phrasings and ensemble outputs (majority vote) to reduce hallucination.
- Few-shot with explicit 'I don't know' examples to teach abstain behavior.
- Use a small local classifier to validate structured outputs (e.g., email regex, date parser) before accepting them upstream.

End of scratchpad. Will tidy and push to repo once we've got 2 stable templates and eval runs passing.
